spec_match.rationale: Uses setMicrophoneActive/setCameraActive as the spec intends (page→UA capture state) and the togglemicrophone/togglecamera/hangup MediaSessionAction handlers (UA→page); state is committed only after awaiting the setter, reverting on rejection as the spec's NotAllowedError path allows.

interactive.rationale: Join, mic, camera, hang-up, opt-in real capture, and stand-in buttons that invoke the exact registered handler functions; event log shows the raw return shape of every push.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises await-then-commit, probed action names, revert on rejection and opt-in capture — all present.

edge_cases.rationale: Rejection-revert branch and unknown-action TypeError (togglescreenshare/voiceactivity rejected by Chromium 153) are real; a UA-side rejection could not be produced on Chromium (it never rejects in a live document), so the revert path is code-reviewed, not observed.

conformance.rationale: Maps to call-action-names-accepted and the returns-promise assertions of the feature suite.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified with headless Chrome for Testing 153 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp is NOT available in this environment, so this is not DevTools-MCP verification). Chrome 153 has the OLD shape; the new-shape branches were exercised only with a test-only init-script shim in the harness (never shipped). Flow: join → mic on → cam on → togglemicrophone stand-in → togglecamera → real capture (fake devices) attached a video tile and set track.enabled → keyboard Enter on mic → hangup stand-in cleared handlers and stopped tracks. Log showed [object Undefined] (default) vs [object Promise] fulfilled (shim). Zero console errors both modes.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5188639100370944 plus the spec section and MDN/WebIDL/HTML references relevant to this concept.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only (bg-paper/stone/ivory, text-charcoal/black/muted, accent-emerald-dark/rose/blue/amber-as-border-only); every button override sets both background and color; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Mic/camera are aria-pressed toggles with aria-busy while awaiting (buttons are not disabled mid-await, so focus is never dropped); focus moves to the mic after join and back to Join after hang-up; status is aria-live polite; self-view video has an aria-label; keyboard Enter toggled the mic in the harness.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at 360x740 (DPR 3, touch, isMobile) and 1280x800: 0px horizontal overflow on both, button rows wrap, 44px targets, screenshots read for both classes.

telemetry_health.rationale: demo-telemetry.js loaded; showcaseTelemetry.assert fires for the primary contract and for the legacy/fallback branch with the raw shape/state as details.

openQuestions.title: Observe real browser media-session UI invoking the handlers
openQuestions.detail: Headless cannot show the PiP/global media controls; verify on a headed Chrome with Document PiP or the global media hub that pressing the browser's mic/camera/hang-up buttons calls the registered handlers and that the indicator follows setXActive().

openQuestions.title: Document PiP composition
openQuestions.detail: The browser shows togglemicrophone/togglecamera/hangup most visibly in a Picture-in-Picture window; a concept that opens a Document PiP call window would show the promise-synchronised state across both windows.

guidanceConsulted.query: toggle button aria-pressed mute microphone camera
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Communicate toggle state with aria-pressed, style :focus-visible, keep targets >=24px (bumped on coarse pointers).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons min-height 44px with :focus-visible outline in --accent-blue; toggles (call page) expose aria-pressed and aria-busy while awaiting.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region for asynchronous result announcements
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-live=polite for standard result/status updates; reserve assertive for critical interruptions; avoid announcing interstitial 'loading' noise.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts/readouts are aria-live polite; per-call result cards and logs are NOT live (they are navigable on demand) to avoid spam.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: flex-wrap:wrap on button rows, min-inline-size:0 on items holding long strings, auto-fit/minmax grids, never mask overflow with overflow:hidden.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Button groups wrap; result grids use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%,Npx),1fr)); outputs use overflow-wrap:anywhere; measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800.

summary: A realistic call bar that keeps app and browser capture state consistent by awaiting the setter (safe on both shapes) and wiring the three call action handlers, with capture strictly opt-in.
